items.text: Rams officially listed WR Puka Nacua questionable for MNF vs Giants (hip); McVay said no Saturday practice, added groin soreness post-Thursday practice, likely pregame decision. Rapoport confirmed no practice.
items.why: New hip injury plus groin soreness; missed Saturday practice.
items.implication: High-stakes GTD; secure Monday FLEX pivot as most options lock earlier.
items.opportunity: If OUT/INACTIVE, boost for Davante Adams and other LAR WRs in routes/targets.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers listed doubtful; team elevated TE Chris Myarick and WR Cody White. ETR board groups as OUT/DOUBTFUL; Schefter confirmed elevations.
items.why: Ongoing knee issue; unlikely to play per standard doubtful tag.
items.implication: Plan without Bowers; TE streaming required for late slate.
items.opportunity: Potential snaps/targets for elevated Myarick or Michael Mayer if active.

items.text: Ravens downgraded WR Zay Flowers to OUT for Sunday vs Saints due to hamstring injury; previously doubtful. Rapoport and ETR corroborated the OUT path with Ja'Kobi Lane also sidelined.
items.why: Hamstring injury from Week 1; official downgrade Saturday.
items.implication: Remove from all lineups; Ravens WR hierarchy collapses to crumbs.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining BAL pass-catchers especially red-zone/TE work.

items.text: Steelers downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT for Sunday vs Patriots due to foot injury. Rapoport confirmed the downgrade from prior Q.
items.why: Foot injury; LP-DNP-DNP practice progression noted by Levitan.
items.implication: PIT WR targets redistribute; avoid Pittman.
items.opportunity: Boost for DK Metcalf and other PIT pass-catchers in share/routes.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins ruled OUT (hamstring) for Sunday vs Bengals after missing practices; listed among Friday OUTs by Schefter and ETR board.
items.implication: HOU WR room depleted; start backups or stream elsewhere.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share and routes for remaining HOU WRs and TE Dalton Schultz.

items.text: Bengals elevated QB Josh Johnson with Joe Burrow questionable (back) but expected to play. Schefter confirmed elevation and Q listing; Burrow previously said missing would be ridiculous; ETR notes said he's playing.
items.why: Back soreness; full or near practices and coach/player comments point to playing.
items.implication: Start Burrow as usual; Johnson is pure emergency.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is the biggest injury on the slate; Q status affects many projections including Justin Herbert. Game at 4pm ET. ETR board lists Q; limited Friday after DNPs.
items.why: Ribs/chest from Week 1 hit; DNP Wed/Thu, limited Fri. Biggest slate impact per Levitan data/projections.
items.implication: Monitor closely; if active may have reduced floor; Herbert ceiling tied to him.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Quentin Johnston and other LAC WRs see target/route expansion.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson listed IN and set for 2026 debut; Patriots desperately need playmakers—do they give him 10+ touches vs Stevenson? ETR board confirms IN after full practices.
items.why: Full practice week; team need for playmakers; Levitan flags 10+ touch upside potential in debut.
items.implication: Monitor snap/carry share; possible flex upside but Stevenson likely retains floor.
items.opportunity: Possible early-down or change-of-pace expansion; handcuff value if explodes.
items.conflict: May split and limit both if committee heavy.

items.text: Alvin Kamara listed IN on ETR Sunday board; expected back. Berry flags Etienne hate due to Kamara squeeze on receiving work and committee with Miller.
items.why: Cleared final injury report; knee issue resolved for debut/return.
items.implication: Kamara reclaims role; Etienne usage compressed especially passing downs.
items.opportunity: Kamara for touches/routes; fade or lower Etienne expectations.

items.text: Giving Christian McCaffrey a bump off Week 1 usage regardless; Kaelon Black (groin) status does matter for SF backfield. ETR notes Black Q.
items.why: Strong Week 1 usage data supports projection increase; Black Q could further consolidate.
items.implication: Lock in as elite RB1; even higher if Black limited/out.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps, carries, routes if Black sidelined.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE: handled 21/24 RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), targeted 40% of routes (team lead) in Week 1. Indy just allowed 163 yards + 3 TDs to Henry. Strong utilization and matchup.
items.why: Elite Week 1 snap/touch/target share plus soft IND run defense.
items.implication: Start with confidence as high-end RB1/RB2; utilization supports smash potential.
items.opportunity: Continued high snap share, routes, and goal-line work.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE: 99 utilization score Week 1 (tied Bijan league lead), 19% target share over last 10 games, 25+ touches in 3 of last 4. Soft LAC matchup on road.
items.why: Elite utilization and consistent passing-game involvement plus volume.
items.implication: Strong start; RB upside locked in via touches and targets.

items.text: Bucky Irving LOVE: RB9 utilization Week 1 with 26% target share and 100% of RB red-zone touches. CLE allowed 121 rush yards/4.8 YPC; out-routed Gainwell.
items.why: Passing-game and goal-line monopoly plus favorable CLE matchup.
items.implication: Elevate in rankings; every-down upside with RZ security.

items.text: Travis Etienne HATE: matched Kendre Miller rush attempts Week 1, 69% fantasy pts via air; Kamara expected back further squeezes receiving role. NO underdogs limits rush script.
items.why: Committee squeeze with Miller + Kamara return on receiving downs; poor game script.
items.implication: Sit or downgrade heavily; volatile low-floor play.
items.conflict: Kamara IN confirmed by ETR reduces Etienne further.
